newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says new bridge has no EMU impact on Portugal.
newsitem.headline: EU says new bridge has no EMU impact on Portugal.

text.p: Financial concessions given by the Portuguese government to a private firm for the construction of a new bridge in Lisbon will have no effect on its 1997 budget deficit, the European Union said on Wednesday.

Eurostat, the EU's statistical office, said, "When a state has given an enterprise the right to exploit a public infrastructure for a particular period of time, no impact on the deficit should be recorded."
The EU office said its decision applied in particular to the "concession given by the Portuguese state to the company Lusoponte for the construction of a new bridge of Lisbon."
It also affects the financing of two other bridges under construction -- "the old one - '25 April' - and the new one - 'Vasco da Gama'."
